'''Hyperbank Conglomerate''' was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] led by [[Sa Nalaor (individual)|Sa Nalaor]], before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
